headline: United's hubs are running normally; a delay program is slowing Seattle arrivals.

items.text: The seven United hubs reporting so far today are running normally, at 84% on time or better.
A ground delay program is in effect for flights into Seattle until 9:59 PM PT, with delays averaging 32 minutes and up to 82 minutes. Those flights are held at their departure airport.

The FAA's operations plan lists four possible programs for tomorrow, none in effect now: flights into Boston tomorrow after 1:00 PM ET, New York LaGuardia tomorrow after 10:00 AM ET, Miami tomorrow after 1:00 PM ET, and San Diego tomorrow after 9:00 AM PT.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying into Seattle, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
